final_answer: BR could not answer this question: it has no node for either source paper (Di Martino et al. 2014, DOI 10.1038/mp.2013.78; Abraham et al. 2017, DOI 10.1016/j.neuroimage.2016.10.045), no node or edge linking a group-difference finding to a leave-site-out/held-out-site result, and kg_verify_hypothesis returned verdict='insufficient_evidence' (confidence 0, zero supporting/conflicting paths) for the generalization claim. kg_multihop_qa only reached generic ABIDE/ASD-connectivity concept nodes connected to unrelated publications. BR therefore cannot state whether Analyst A's group effect holds in Analyst B's held-out sites.

No BR-KG node exists for Di Martino et al. 2014 (doi:10.1038/mp.2013.78) or Abraham et al. 2017 (doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2016.10.045).

br_limitations: BR-KG does not index these two specific papers (no DOI-addressable node for either), has no edge type connecting a 'group difference' finding to a 'cross-site classification accuracy' or 'held-out site' result, carries no per-site effect-size or replication statistics for ABIDE, and cannot join to the ABIDE phenotype CSV or analyst-defined cohorts (QC threshold changes, CC200/filt_noglobal pipeline choice). Its hypothesis-verification and multi-hop tools repeatedly degraded to generic ASD-connectivity concept matches rather than the specific papers/claim requested, and one long-form hypothesis call failed outright on a server-side query-size error.
